The SJC unanimously sustained the appeal and reversed the Presbytery's action, holding that Evans had withdrawn from Presbytery's jurisdiction under BCO 38-3a before the divestiture proceedings began, and instructed the Presbytery to record the irregularity, acknowledge his new membership, and remove his name from the roll.

artifacts.synopsis: The Standing Judicial Commission heard an appeal by TE John Grady from his conviction and censure by Southwest Florida Presbytery. The Commission sustained three of seven error specifications but found only one materially prejudicial. Critically, the Commission found that Presbytery misapplied BCO 13-9.c by claiming power to direct the minister to resign and then censuring him for refusal to comply; the Commission vacated the censure and remanded for reconsideration of appropriate punishment while the administrative suspension under BCO 31-10 remained in effect.

The SJC held that the Session had not conducted a trial, but that presbytery erred by failing to remand the matter under BCO 42-9 for proper process or dismissal; the complaint was sustained and sent back for rehearing.

artifacts.title: Carolyn Goerig v. Pacific Northwest Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: The SJC sustained the complaint, finding that the Session of Faith Presbyterian Church failed to follow BCO 38-4 procedures when it attempted to retroactively erase Carolyn Goerig's membership after banning her from attending services, and that the Presbytery erred in denying her complaint. Because her membership transfer to another church was never completed, she remained under Faith PC's jurisdiction per BCO 46-3.

artifacts.synopsis: The Standing Judicial Commission sustained an appeal by E. L. Fitzsimmons against Evangel Presbytery's handling of his appeal from excommunication. The court found that Presbytery erred by failing to notify the appellant of the time, date, and place for hearing the appeal and by rescinding its earlier finding that the appeal was in order, thus failing to adjudicate the appeal properly. The case was remanded to Evangel Presbytery for proper adjudication on the merits.
